_what: Every value below is the BUILT-IN DEFAULT, so this file changes nothing if you pass it as-is. It is a reference for what exists and what it is set to, not a deployment you should copy unedited.
_optional: Every key is optional. An absent key leaves the default alone, so a real config is usually three or four lines.
_precedence: The file is read first and command-line flags overwrite it; --help names the key each flag sets. Precedence is NOT positional: a flag wins whether it appears before or after --config. Passing --config twice is an error.
_strict: Unknown keys are a startup ERROR, never ignored: a silently-skipped typo is how an operator ends up believing a setting took effect. Wrong types, bad enum values and out-of-range numbers are refused the same way. Keys beginning with _ are comments.
_secrets: 此文件展示上游原版的兼容默认值，不适合公网多用户部署。安全模式请参见 app/ai-gateway.example.json：所有真实密钥由环境变量提供。
_pinned: app/tests/config_test.cpp asserts these values equal the constants in the code, so this file cannot drift from the defaults it claims to document.

security._warning: 默认不启动服务：须配置 security.enabled=true 和 users，或仅本地兼容测试显式启用 security.legacy_mode=true。
security._allow_insecure_http: 安全模式默认需要 TLS；仅隔离本地 Mock 可显式设置 allow_insecure_http=true。

listen._port: The one listening port. With workers > 1 every worker binds it with SO_REUSEPORT.
listen._tls: TLS-only listener. ONE LISTENER, ONE MODE: there is no second plaintext port, so 'am I exposed in the clear?' has one answer. Needs a TLS build (-DLLMBRIDGE_TLS=ON). Setting this true REQUIRES cert and key below; setting it false requires them ABSENT, because a certificate with no TLS listener is the shape where an operator believes the port is encrypted and it is not.
listen._cert: Certificate chain, PEM. Omitted by default because tls is false. Example: /etc/llmbridge/cert.pem
listen._key: Private key, PEM, and it must not be readable beyond its owner (chmod 600) or startup refuses it. Example: /etc/llmbridge/key.pem

_upstream_table: upstream 可以是单个对象，也可以是多个上游组成的数组。数组顺序决定上游索引，内置 routing 策略会根据健康状态和路由模式选择上游。strip_headers 对整个网关生效。

upstream._url: IP:PORT, HOST:PORT, or http(s)://HOST[:PORT]. https:// needs a TLS build and verifies both the chain and the hostname, with no way to disable it. A non-loopback plaintext upstream warns at startup, because a forwarded credential would cross the network in the clear.
upstream._dialect: What this venue speaks: openai | anthropic | gemini | cohere | bedrock | azure. A client already speaking the venue's dialect is byte-forwarded, whichever it is. The old key name "translate" and the old value "none" are refused by name.
upstream._strip_headers: 转发前删除的请求头名称，不区分大小写且精确匹配；默认空列表。可阻止内部路由头或网关身份凭据传给第三方，剥离的 Authorization 也不会被提升为 Provider 凭据。最多 64 个名称，每个最多 64 字节，须为合法 HTTP 字段名。
upstream._credential_header: 可选的 x-kottos-key-* 客户端请求头，用于携带该上游的密钥。只会转发被选中上游对应的密钥。
upstream._credential_env: 安全模式中保存 Provider Key 的环境变量名；默认兼容模式不使用。
upstream._model: 可选的上游模型名称；空字符串表示保留客户端请求的模型。
upstream._models: 可选的客户端模型池。多上游时一旦某项配置 models，每个上游都必须配置非空列表；model 是发给 Provider 的映射名，含义不同。

routing._mode: first 优先第一个上游并在传输故障后切换；round_robin 轮询；sticky 根据会话头或请求前缀哈希选择。
routing._max_attempts: 响应尚未发送给客户端时，一次请求最多尝试的上游数量。
routing._failure_threshold: 连续出现传输错误、408、429 或 5xx 后，后续请求暂时跳过该上游的阈值。
routing._cooldown_s: 异常上游的冷却秒数；全部上游都在冷却时仍允许一次探测。
routing._sticky_header: 客户端为每段对话提供的稳定会话标识请求头。
routing._drained_upstreams: SIGHUP 可热更新；填写上游数组索引的字符串，摘除后不再分配新请求，已在途请求继续完成。其他配置改动须重启。
routing._allow_unsafe_replay: 默认禁止重放可能已被上游执行的请求。设置 true 才允许完整错误响应/已发送请求的自动重试；可能重复执行和计费。

management._port: AI-llm-transplot 管理端口。0 表示关闭；启用后只绑定 127.0.0.1，不能通过公网代理暴露。

timeouts._upstream_s: Upstream silence before a request or stream is aborted. 0 disables.
timeouts._client_idle_s: An established client that goes quiet loses its descriptor. Three days by default. This is a descriptor bound for an exposed listener, NOT a load-balancing device: a short window charges a reconnecting client a fresh TCP+TLS handshake to solve a problem the client cannot see. Requests and streams in flight are never reaped. 0 disables.
timeouts._connect_s: How long a fresh upstream connect may take, TCP and TLS handshake together, before the request fails over or gets a 502. The kernel keeps retrying a SYN for about two minutes, and a provider that retires an address (AWS rotates its front ends on a short TTL) answers nothing at all, so without this a request to it waited that long. On a timeout the venue moves to its next resolved address and its name is resolved again. 0 disables.
timeouts._body_streamed: The three below bound a body forwarded as it arrives (runtime.stream_body), which holds a connection to the venue, and a second descriptor, until its last byte. A body that misses them is cut: the client gets 408 and its connection closes, the venue's connection is reset, so it holds part of a body short of its Content-Length and never runs it. A held body is not affected.
timeouts._body_min_rate: The least average upload, in bytes a second, once the grace is over: a body gets body_grace_s, and one second more for every body_min_rate bytes it delivers. 1024 (8 kbit/s, below even a 2G data link) never cuts a client whose link is merely slow, however large its body. A pause is covered by the time its earlier bytes earned, up to timeouts.upstream_s: a body that sends nothing for longer is cut as a client stall, whatever it earned. A client trickling a byte now and then is cut once its grace runs out. 0 disables.
timeouts._body_grace_s: How long a streamed body may take before the minimum rate applies, covering a connection's slow start and a client that sends its head first.
timeouts._body_s: A limit on a streamed body's whole upload, from its head to its last byte. Off by default: any such limit cuts a client on a slow link once its body is large enough, and the minimum rate already makes a slow upload pay for its time. Set it where every client is known to be fast. 0 disables.
timeouts._pool_idle_s: How long a pooled upstream connection may sit unused before it is closed. Every worker keeps its OWN pool, so offered traffic divides across them, each pool crosses this line more often, and every crossing costs the next request a full reconnect and TLS handshake. Raise it when running several workers, or once routing spreads traffic across several upstreams. 0 disables reaping.

runtime._io: auto | epoll | uring. auto prefers io_uring and falls back to epoll when it is unavailable.
runtime._log_level: trace | debug | info | warn | error | off. Lines BELOW the level compiled in at build time do not exist at all, so raising this at runtime cannot resurrect them: build with -DLLMBRIDGE_LOG_LEVEL=debug for the per-connection lines. Release compiles in info and above so the published latency numbers are measured on what ships.
runtime._request_log: AI-llm-transplot 有界异步 JSON 请求日志；不输出密钥或正文，默认关闭以保持数据面开销。
runtime._workers: 1 to 4096 shared-nothing event loops, one thread each, all binding the same port with SO_REUSEPORT. The kernel picks a worker per CONNECTION by hashing the 4-tuple, so a single keep-alive client stays on one worker for that connection's life; a client wanting to spread across workers opens several connections.
runtime._timing_headers: Per-request x-llmbridge-* response headers splitting the request into disjoint spans. Metadata only, no prompt or completion text. Defined precisely in LATENCY.md.
runtime._prefault_mb: Megabytes to reserve and write through in every request buffer before it carries a request: the gateway's two scratch strings at start, each upstream connection's send buffer when it opens. Without it the first request through each buffer faults in fresh pages as it is written, measured at 2.6 ms for a 10 MB agent context. Memory is this size times the number of pooled upstream connections, resident for the life of the process, so leave it at 0 for small requests and set it to the largest request body you expect (16 for Claude Code sessions) when they are large.
runtime._retain_mb: Megabytes of JSON parse storage (the node arena and the parser's stacks, each) a worker keeps between translated bodies, 0 to 16. Past it a large body's storage is freed after the request, so the next one allocates afresh. Raise it to 16 when bodies of several megabytes are common: it costs up to twice this much resident memory per worker.
runtime._stream_body: "on" (default) forwards a byte-forwarded body of 16 KiB or more to the venue as it arrives, so the venue does not wait for the whole upload. "off" holds every body until its last byte, for every client, exactly as before 0.90.0. A translated body, a body under 16 KiB, a compressed one, and every body while a policy is installed are always held.
runtime._stream_body_max: How many bodies one worker forwards as they arrive at once, 0 to 1048576, 0 for no cap. Each holds a connection to the venue, and a second descriptor, until its last byte, so a client uploading slowly holds both for as long as it takes. Past the cap a body is held to its last byte as before 0.90.0, with one descriptor and no venue connection, and bounded as a held body is: on a connection's first request it must arrive within the 30 s setup deadline, so while the cap is reached an upload slower than that on a fresh connection is closed.
runtime._stream_openai_body: "on" (default) forwards an OpenAI client's byte-forwarded body as it arrives too, each chunk checked first: a repeated or escaped top-level key, or a byte that is not JSON, stops it, resets the upstream and answers 400. "off" holds an OpenAI client's body until its last byte; other clients' bodies follow stream_body alone.
runtime._duration_s: Self-stop after N seconds (fractions allowed; SIGINT/SIGTERM still stop it at once) and print the added-latency profile, for scripted benchmark runs. 0 runs until SIGINT/SIGTERM.
runtime._warmup_s: Exclude the first N seconds from the histograms.
